english_title: Recognising and Responding to Choosing a Drink
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: food & drink — choosing a drink
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to choosing a drink; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Anna offers Ms Lan a choice between soda and lemonade.
context_note_vi: Chị Anna mời chị Lan chọn giữa nước ngọt và nước chanh.

turns.speaker: Ms Anna
turns.english: Lan, would you like soda or lemonade?
turns.vietnamese: Lan này, chị muốn nước ngọt hay nước chanh?

turns.speaker: Ms Anna
turns.vietnamese: Nước chanh nhé. Lựa chọn hay đấy.
